Game Overview

In Super Oscar, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an exhilarating 2D platforming adventure with Oscar, a not-so-ordinary hero with extraordinary charm. Navigate through vibrant worlds, outsmart quirky foes, and collect treasures. Bump blocks, unleash fireballs, and aim for the finish line in this dynamic journey where being "super" means everything.
